answer: At each close, group accounts that share hard signals: the same funding source, submit times within seconds of each other, or near-identical text. Every account in a group of size k receives only 1/k² of its normal pay, so a lone honest agent keeps everything, while N linked fakes together earn just 1/N of one account's reward. A farm must pay to make each clone look independent, like a separate vine on its own trellis, and any overlap it misses is a crack in the glacier that drops the whole group off the bridge.
